subject: 飛行員招募評估 - 面試、履歷與模擬機考選準備

mc_questions.zh_question: 根據教官的建議,在參加針對新機型(New Type)的模擬機評核(Simulator Assessment)時,考官最看重的核心能力為何？
zh_options: (B) 對該機型系統手冊的背誦能力
(C) 資源管理 (CRM) 與非正常情況的管理能力
(D) 儀表飛行的航道保持精度
mc_questions.en_question: According to the instructor, what is the core competency that examiners value most during a simulator assessment for a new aircraft type?
en_options: (B) Rote memorization of the aircraft system manual
(C) CRM (Crew Resource Management) and management of non-normals
mc_questions.explanation: 教官強調,針對新機型,航空公司知道你沒飛過,所以不會專注於落地好壞,而是觀察你的 CRM、團隊合作以及在壓力下管理非正常情況 (Management of non-normals) 的能力。

mc_questions.zh_question: 在小組討論或小組活動面試中,應徵者應該抱持什麼樣的觀念？
zh_options: (A) 展現出最強的領導力以壓過其他人
(B) 其他人都是潛在的競爭對手 (Competitors)
(D) 其他人是合作夥伴,應展現團隊協作能力
mc_questions.en_question: What mindset should a candidate maintain during a group exercise or interview?
en_options: (A) Demonstrate the strongest leadership to overpower others
(B) View others as potential competitors for the job
(C) Remain silent to avoid making mistakes
(D) View others as collaborators and demonstrate teamwork skills
mc_questions.explanation: 教官指出,許多應徵者誤將同組人視為競爭對手,但航空公司可能錄取整組人或一個都不錄取,重點在於觀察你如何與團隊溝通、協作以及在壓力下的表現。

mc_questions.zh_question: 關於航空公司的職位申請要求(Application Requirements),下列敘述何者正確？
zh_options: (A) 如果只差幾小時飛行時數,可以先投遞履歷
(B) 應務必在完全符合所有準則後再申請,以免留下被拒紀錄影響未來
(C) 如果有綠卡問題,錄取後再解決即可
(D) 申請表上的細節(如飛過的航點)不重要,面試再談即可
mc_questions.en_question: Regarding airline application requirements, which of the following statements is correct?
en_options: (A) You can apply first even if you are a few flight hours short
(B) You must meet all criteria before applying to avoid a rejection record impacting your future
(C) Green card issues can be resolved after being hired
(D) Details on the application form (e.g., destinations flown) are not important and can be discussed during the interview
mc_questions.explanation: 教官強調必須「Meet all the requirements」才申請。未達標即申請可能導致被拒絕,甚至在未來符合資格時,仍因先前的拒絕紀錄或罰則 (Penalties) 受到影響。

cloze_items.cloze_text: In the simulator assessment, the instructors want to see your {{c1::CRM}}, teamwork, and management of non-normals.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 在模擬機評估中,教官想要看到的是你的資源管理(CRM)、團隊合作以及對非正常情況的管理。
cloze_items.explanation: 對於不熟悉的機種,飛行技巧是其次,跨職能合作與情境意識才是評核重點。

cloze_items.cloze_text: Your interview starts at the {{c1::airport}} when you board their airplane or step into their facilities.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 當你登上他們的飛機或踏入他們的設施時,你的面試就已經在機場開始了。
cloze_items.explanation: 航空公司會從應徵者與地勤、空服員或飯店員工的互動中觀察其職業素養。

cloze_items.cloze_text: Though it is not a mandatory requirement, I strongly recommend you to have a {{c1::university degree}} for the applications.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 雖然這不是強制性要求,但我強烈建議你在申請時具備大學學位。
cloze_items.explanation: 在競爭激烈的招募中,大學學位能讓申請者更具優勢,尤其是在美國的航空公司。

cloze_items.cloze_text: When answering behavioral questions, use the {{c1::STAR}} technique or a similar methodological thinking process to explain your situation.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 回答行為面試題時,使用 STAR 原則或類似的方法論思考過程來解釋你的情況。
cloze_items.explanation: 航空公司想看的是你解決問題的邏輯架構,而不僅僅是故事內容。
